say: Check every 15 minutes whether my blog at blog.example.org is responding, and tell me if it goes down.
Every morning at 7, look at forecast.weather.gov for Boston and tell me if it's going to rain.
Keep an eye on https://www.githubstatus.com and let me know if anything there changes.
Every Friday at 5pm, check the price on https://example.com/product/42 and tell me what it is.
Watch tickets.example.net every 30 minutes and tell me as soon as tickets go on sale.
Each day at noon, open news.ycombinator.com and tell me if any story on the front page mentions Rust.
